stories.title: Maldives president arrives in Pakistan for three-day visit
stories.brief: Maldives President Dr Mohamed Muizzu arrived in Islamabad on Tuesday on a three-day visit to Pakistan, according to a statement from his office.

stories.title: Pakistani national who allegedly defrauded US Postal Service of $126m arrested in Lahore: NCCIA
stories.brief: LAHORE: The National Cyber Crime Investigation Agency said on Tuesday that a prime suspect in a case involving the sale of counterfeit US postage stamps had been arrested in Lahore.

stories.title: NCCIA arrests Khanewal man indicted in $126m US postal fraud case
stories.brief: According to the NCCIA, Akram allegedly operated the scheme from August 2023 till last month, selling counterfeit shipping labels for around $2 each. It allegedly offered counterfeit postage at a fixed price, irrespective of a parcel’s weight, size or destination, allowing customers to ship packages at rates substantially below legitimate postal charges.

stories.title: Maldives president lands in Pakistan for three-day state visit
stories.brief: Maldives President Mohamed Muizzu arrived in Islamabad on Tuesday for a three-day state visit to Pakistan from October 20 to October 22, at the invitation of Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif, according to state media.

stories.title: Mission blasts off for Mars to grab a piece of its moon
stories.brief: A spacecraft is set to launch on an ambitious mission to bring 10g of Martian moon dust back to Earth.

stories.title: On-duty cop martyred in firing by attackers in KP's Miranshah: police
stories.brief: District Police Officer (DPO) Sajjad Hussain confirmed the details to Dawn, saying that additional SHO Meera Khan was targeted when he was on duty. “He sustained multiple bullet wounds and succumbed to his injuries,” the DPO said.

stories.title: Police officer martyred in gun attack near Miranshah bypass
stories.brief: An additional station house officer (SHO) of Miranshah Police Station was martyred when unidentified armed men opened fire on him near Miranshah Bypass in Khyber-Pakhtunkhwa's North Waziristan on Tuesday evening, police officials confirmed.

stories.title: Elon Musk says Tesla-SpaceX merger being considered
stories.brief: Musk says special committees within both companies have been formed to look at a possible mega-merger.

stories.title: Ex-OpenAI worker accused of planting bug had Saudi support, claims prosecutors
stories.brief: Abdulrahman Alfozan, who is accused of planting a recording device, has been denied bail.

stories.title: Ban on PTI may no longer be needed after governor’s rule in K-P: Tarar
stories.brief: The emergency and governor’s rule were declared on October 11 after negotiations between the government and opposition failed, culminating in a PTI long march towards Islamabad that began on October 4.

stories.title: Balochistan govt rejects comparison with K-P, says cooperating with Centre on combatting terrorism
stories.brief: The Balochistan government on Tuesday rejected comparisons with the former provincial government of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa (K-P), stating that, unlike the latter, it was cooperating with the federal government in the fight against terrorism.

stories.title: The tech helping crack decades-old cold cases
stories.brief: Investigative genetic genealogy can help hunt down criminals but raises worries over privacy.

stories.title: Audit regulator looking into Manchester City accounting
stories.brief: No formal investigation has started, but the regulator is making inquiries into the case.

stories.title: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman wins dismissal of sister's lawsuit
stories.brief: A US district judge dismissed the case after Ann Altman had refused to attend an independent medical examination.

stories.title: Trump sued over Canadian tariffs in latest legal challenge
stories.brief: The lawsuit argues the White House exceeded its authority in imposing the latest tariffs on the country and caused "immediate harm to American businesses".

stories.title: UK to deploy fighter jets to defend Saudi Arabia
stories.brief: British Typhoon jets will carry out defensive missions to protect Saudi Arabia from escalating Houthi attacks.

stories.title: Google resolves cloud outage affecting UK banks and websites
stories.brief: Revolut was one of the hardest hit, with banking services going down for many customers.

stories.title: Huge fin whale filmed off Welsh coast
stories.brief: Rhys Morgan captured footage of the world's second-largest whale species lunge feeding on his drone.

stories.title: Moment giant fin whale's huge mouth engulfs thousands of gallons of water
stories.brief: Videographer Rhys Morgan captured footage of the worlds second largest whale lunge feeding on his drone.

stories.title: 'I'm fed up of swiping': The singles choosing dating events over apps
stories.brief: The BBC hears from people who think dating events are better value for money than dating apps.
